runs.name: The Hong Kong and China Gas Company Limited; OTC ADS HOKCY at one ordinary per ADS, Hong Kong 0003, no SEC annual report, read from its own annual reports in HKD; Hong Kong town gas and mainland city gas
runs.file: 2026-10-18 Run - HOKCY Hong Kong and China Gas.md
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: Price **HK$7.215** a share (SEHK 0003 close 2026-10-16) and US$0.86 an ADS (OTC close 2026-10-16, thinly traded), both Yahoo, **aggregator, live quote only, flagged**; ADS ratio one ordinary share per ADS (F-6EF of 2007-07-13, accession 0001144204-07-036452; SEC CIK 0000810039 holds only that F-6EF and paper 12g3-2(b) submissions to 2010); HK$1 = US$0.12742 (aggregator, flagged, inside the HKMA's 7.75 to 7.85 band). Shares 18,659,870,098 issued at 2026-06-30 and 2025-12-31, no treasury shares (Interim Report 2026, note 14), last bonus issue 2021 at one for twenty; `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` returned not an SEC registrant, all arithmetic by hand in the research folder's scripts. Earnings currency judged the HKD (Hong Kong earns more than half of the filer's own operating-profit line; the box does not turn on it). Sovereign **4.246%**, the 20-year HKD HKSAR Institutional Government Bonds re-opening tender of 2026-07-22 (Hong Kong Monetary Authority press release), the longest HKD tenor; the HKMA daily-yield API refused every request (HTTP 405), so no October 20-year print was read, the 10-year at 3.986% indicative on 2026-10-14 shown beside; no HKD row in the table. Read from the Annual Reports 2017 to 2025 (HKEXnews; AR2025 2026-04-28) and the Interim Report 2026. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the reports' segment note, Financial Review, risk disclosures and Directors' Report, stated in the run file. **Q1 IN**: a gas utility read by its two parts, Hong Kong town gas (2,056 thousand customers) and mainland city-gas concessions held largely through Towngas Smart Energy, about 70.11% owned; slow-moving utility variables. **Q2 IN**: the decider depends on the definition, Hong Kong 53% of 2021 to 2025 operating profit on the filer's line, the mainland 52% with the shares of associates and joint ventures added; both castles read, confessed as a CONVENTION of the run; Hong Kong a single network with pricing power through the last inflation (4.4% tariff rise 2022, another 2024), about 22% pre-tax on segment assets, narrowing slowly, volume 29,550 to 27,181 million MJ 2018 to 2025; the mainland about 5% pre-tax at a regulated and falling return, carried to Q3 as a second best. **Q3 weighs against**: capital spending about twice depreciation buying revenue growth of 0.35% a year. **Q4 weighs against, no STOP**: ten balance sheets read, shareholders' funds HK$60.4bn 2017 and HK$59.4bn 2025, net debt about HK$25bn to HK$52.6bn (June 2026), 'core operating profit' featured, impairments HK$1.5bn 2021 and HK$3.2bn 2023. **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs against**: integrity facts recorded and judged, the chairman's private funds holding shares in EcoCeres beside the group's interest, the independent director since 1984 chairing the audit and remuneration committees while his bank lends HK$682.6M to the group. **Q6 weighs against on both parts**: the retention test fails over the five-year span, dividends HK$32.5bn against profit HK$27.7bn 2021 to 2025 while debt rose, earnings per share HK$0.44 (2017) to HK$0.31 (2025); pay not tied to capital. **Q7 OUT on the floor**: owner cash five-year average 2021 to 2025 HK$4,021M all spending and purchases deducted (default pair, net purchases a net sale of about HK$768M, not a serial acquirer), HK$3,867M organic, HK$7,567M with depreciation as the maintenance guess, minority dividends deducted; floor tested first, best expected return 4.04% all-equity, 4.16% equity-only, owner cash would need about 13% a year for ten years to earn ten percent. Value range HK$2.26 to HK$6.73 a share all-equity at the sovereign (equity-only HK$2.59 to HK$7.07), the price above every case; **fair price HK$0.29 a share, US$0.037 an ADS all-equity** (the average of a negative bottom end and a positive top end), equity-only HK$2.05, US$0.261 an ADS; with non-controlling interests at book the all-equity fair is about HK$(0.02). The report names no rival; ENN Energy, China Resources Gas and HK Electric chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, none an SEC filer, read from their own annual reports: ENN profit to net assets 21.3% falling to 12.6%, CR Gas profit to equity 15.6% to 7.5%, HK Electric a fixed 8% permitted return on net fixed assets, HKCG 7.6% to 10.1%; CLP Holdings and Kunlun Energy not read. For a later run: the fixed-price Australian gas contract ends inside ten years. Contamination declared by the analyst: ten run-file names dated 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 in a Test Runs directory listing, XNGSY commit subjects with its box, range and RMB sovereign (ENN is a rival read here; every ENN figure taken from ENN's own report, the RMB figure deliberately not used), the memory index; none used. Process note: Q2 committed with Q1, Q3 to Q6 in one commit. Commits 1cf8e222 (template), 414555ae (Step 0, Q1, Q2), bd8b826a (Q3 to Q6), 9f25ca82 (Q7 with the buyback line written back, the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 68 ids, no E-ids, 39 quoted fragments beside an id, 0 slips; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): whether Q2's 'operating profit' includes equity-accounted shares, which here names the decider; specifics (e) and (f) and (b) pulling against each other on a series that changes sign; minority interests on the all-equity basis; a negative end in Part VII's fair-price average; no HKD sovereign row, a 20-year longest tenor, how stale a sovereign may be, and a group earning in two currencies.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7, on the floor (Hong Kong and China Gas, read from its own annual reports in HKD; Q1 IN, Q2 IN on the Hong Kong town gas network with pricing power, narrowing slowly, and mainland concessions at a regulated, falling return carried as a second best; Q3, Q4 and Q6 against, spending twice depreciation, dividends above profit while net debt doubled, earnings per share HK$0.44 to HK$0.31; Q5 integrity IN, ability against; best expected return 4.04% all-equity; value range HK$2.26 to HK$6.73 at the 4.246% HKD 20-year sovereign of July, the price HK$7.215 above every case; fair HK$0.29 a share, US$0.037 an ADS all-equity, equity-only US$0.261; armed at the all-equity ADS figure. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: equity-accounted shares in Q2's operating profit, (b), (e) and (f) on a sign-changing series, minority interests, a negative end in the fair-price average, no HKD sovereign row and a stale print.)
